card.name: Fraction characters in amounts
card.fires_on: Unicode vulgar fraction characters such as ¼, ½, ¾, including their broken byte pieces, in measurements. They appear before units like inch, cup, tsp or tablet.

modes.description: A fraction sign gives a size or spoon, cup or tablet amount.

modes.description: The first or second byte piece of a fraction character that was split up.
